title: 否定与信息修正
goal: 判断否定表达的范围，辨认修正后成立的信息。

points.label: 判断否定表达限定的事实
选出修正后仍然成立的信息

sources.title: 高考英语（新课标卷）：课表
sources.used: 否定与修正的教学内容及课程小测规格

body.p: 否定词说明哪个动作或状态不成立。说话者也会在后面修正时间、地点等信息，答题以修正后的信息为准。

body.box: The report isn't ready yet. / The meeting is on Monday. Actually, it's on Tuesday.

body.p: 第一句说明报告还没有完成。第二组把会议日期修正为周二。

cards.title: 否定表达
rows: 过去成立，现在已经停止。
The shop no longer sells bread.
程度或数量很少，接近没有。
There is hardly any milk left.
否定后面的动作或状态：今天蓝色房间不能用。
The blue room isn't available today.

cards.title: 信息修正
rows: I planned to walk, but I'll take the bus.
The room was open, but it's closed now.
The talk is on Tuesday. Actually, it's on Wednesday.
The book is on the desk. Actually, it's on the shelf.
Meet at five, I mean six.
Take the blue folder, I mean the green one.

body.box:
A: Has the new café opened?
B: Not yet. It will open next week.
A: Then we'll visit next week.

What is true of the café?
1. It opened last week.
2. It has not opened yet.
3. It was visited last week.
4. It closes next week.

body.p: Not yet 回答的是是否已经开业，意思是说话时还没有开业。第二项与此一致。

lines.text: Has the report for the garden project been finished? I need to send it to the committee before its meeting tomorrow.
Not yet. I'm checking the final page this afternoon.

items.stem: What is the report's current status?
options: It no longer has a final page.
items.why: Not yet 回应完成情况，说明报告尚未完成。

lines.text: The art club meets in Room Four tomorrow. Actually, the room is being painted, so the meeting is in Room Seven.
I'll tell the other members about the change.

items.stem: Where will the club meet tomorrow?
options: In Room Seven, not Room Four
items.why: actually 后给出变更后的地点 Room Seven。

lines.text: Does the café still sell soup at lunch? I used to buy it there when I worked nearby, and I'm visiting the area today.
It no longer sells soup, but it still serves sandwiches.

items.stem: What does the café serve now?
items.why: no longer sells soup 表示停止卖汤，still serves sandwiches 表示仍供应三明治。

lines.text: Please bring the red folder to the meeting. I mean the yellow folder; the red one contains notes from last month's meeting.
All right. I'll bring the yellow one.

items.why: I mean the yellow folder 修正前面的 red folder。

lines.text: Has the printer delivered the posters for the concert? We need to put them up before the tickets go on sale tomorrow.
Not yet. The printer expects to bring them this afternoon.

items.stem: What is true of the posters?
items.why: Not yet 回答是否送达，说明海报尚未到达。

lines.text: I thought the film started at six. Actually, I checked the programme again: it starts at seven, after the short talk here at the gallery.
Then we have time for the talk first.

items.why: actually 后修正为 starts at seven, after the short talk。

lines.text: Do you still cycle to the station every morning? I remember seeing your bicycle outside the station when we worked together.
I no longer cycle there. I walk to the station now.

items.stem: How does the second speaker reach the station now?
items.why: no longer cycle 与 walk to the station now 说明现在步行。

lines.text: Let's meet at the east entrance at four. I mean the west entrance; the east entrance is closed for repairs today.
All right. I'll wait at the west entrance before the visit.

items.why: I mean the west entrance 修正东侧入口，回应也确认西侧入口。

lines.text: Is there enough paper left for the class? I need to print the activity sheets before the students arrive this afternoon.
There's hardly any paper left. I'll get another pack from the office.

items.why: hardly any paper left 表示剩余的纸很少。

lines.text: I was going to take the morning bus to the garden, but I'll take the afternoon bus because my appointment ends at noon.
I'll meet you at the garden in the afternoon.

items.stem: Which bus will the first speaker take?
options: The morning bus to the garden
The afternoon bus to the garden
The morning bus to the appointment
The afternoon bus to the appointment
items.why: but I'll take the afternoon bus 修正了原来的上午计划。
